business_problem: Georgian College had accumulated disconnected service systems across seven campuses, making it hard for students to reach IT, registration, finance, housing, and other support services through a single, consistent, self-service experience.
solution_summary: Georgian College designed a single student-services platform around IT Service Management, Customer Service Management, and Workflow Data Fabric, using student interviews and iterative prototypes to shape the experience. The resulting portal keeps knowledge, cases, and interactions in one place so students can move across services without leaving the environment, whether they need help with fees, housing, registration, or IT. Workflow Data Fabric and robotic process automation components remove bottlenecks behind the scenes, while the integrated dashboard gives staff a consolidated view of student cases and interactions across all campuses. Because the college standardized service expectations and governance on top of the platform, teams can collaborate on the student's behalf rather than handing work across separate systems. This let Georgian turn portal traffic, knowledge consumption, and retention signals into measurable operational improvements as well as a more consumer-grade student experience.

solution_components.name: IT Service Management
solution_components.role: Supports core campus IT requests within the college's unified student-service environment.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management
solution_components.role: Coordinates student-facing cases and interactions across multiple service domains.

solution_components.name: Workflow Data Fabric
solution_components.role: Integrates service data and RPA-driven workflows so student support remains seamless across campuses.

data_flow: Students use one portal for knowledge, service requests, and case updates across IT, registration, finance, housing, and other campus services. ITSM and CSM keep those interactions on shared workflows, while Workflow Data Fabric and RPA components synchronize data and remove back-office bottlenecks so staff see a consolidated view of each student's journey.
business_outcome: Georgian reached 92% first-contact resolution, cut median student-request resolution time to under 24 hours, saved about $75,000 annually, connected students to 95% of student services through one portal, reduced registrar emails, calls, and walk-ups by about 20%, and improved domestic retention by 7%.
